name: GR-1
summary: The first humanoid from Fourier Intelligence, a company that came out of rehabilitation robotics, so GR-1 is pitched partly at elderly care and physical assistance as well as general research. It has high-torque joints, can carry loads around half its body weight, and is sold to labs and integrators; GR-2 followed in 2024.
notable: Rehabilitation-robotics maker's pivot into general humanoids
High payload-to-weight ratio for care tasks
